clues: A mountain conservation landscape is also a home of living cultural traditions, rather than empty wilderness.
Snow leopards and red pandas are among the rare animals described in its World Heritage account.
Glaciers and deep valleys shape the landscape around its exceptionally high peaks.
Sherpa communities are closely associated with this protected Himalayan landscape in Nepal.
Find the Nepalese national park dominated by Mount Everest, the world’s highest peak.
